raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed the race might have been run on a 440-yard track and stated that if Prowell finished, he would have run 24 laps. This is wrong for two reasons: (1) the 1967 Pan American Games were held on a metric (400 m) track, making a 10,000 m race 25 laps; and (2) even on a 440-yard track, 10,000 m would be about 24.85 laps, not exactly 24. This misapplication of historical/technical context led to an incorrect lap count assumption.
